EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: MTR/LND/ACQUI/L2/3921. I, hereby give Notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: The below mentioned land located in the Kekanadura East Grama Niladhari Division in Matara Divisional Secretariat Division, Matara District, Southern Province, depicted as lot 01 and 02 in the prelimining plan No. 2588, has been acquired for the repairing of the main canal of the Kekanadura project where it has been damaged due to a landslide. SCHEDULE 01. Lot No. 01
Name of Land: Kotigalkandawaththa; Particulars of Land: Open barrand land; Owner: Wedaththa Lanka Pvt. (Ltd.) No. 40, Gallface teres, Colombo 03; Extent: 0.0403 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02
Name of Land: Kotigalkandawaththa; Particulars of Land: Open barrand land; Owner: Wedaththa Lanka Pvt. (Ltd.) No. 40, Gallface teres, Colombo 03; Extent: 0.3040 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by Agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Matara Divisional Secretariat on the 10th of March, 2015 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd of March, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. RANJITH YAPA, Divisional Secretary, Matara.
